label: AI Insight UI — Dispatcher
info:
Root dispatcher per FAP General Guideline §10.

Every inbound message from the SPA flows: uibuilder in → fn_normalize → fn_validate → switch by msg._req.action → responsibility subflow link-out. Every outbound result flows: link-from-response → fn_build_response (wraps FAP §9 envelope) → merge-session-send → uibuilder.

Legacy topic-based routing (msg.data.topic) is supported as a transition path during Phase 3 — legacy messages bypass the FAP envelope wrapping and pass through merge-session-send unchanged. After Phase 3.4 the legacy path is removed.

FAP Guideline reference: §10 (root dispatcher + responsibility subflows), §11 (one-handler reducer), §9 (envelopes).

label: Session Context
info:
Per-client session lifecycle implemented per FAP §11 (refresh recovery rule). Receives UIBUILDER control events ('client connect' / 'client disconnect' / 'ready') via link-from-uib-control and maintains flow.context().get('sessions') keyed by _socketId. Each entry tracks connectedAt, conversationHistory (last 20 messages), and preferences.

Also implements:
  - bootstrap.session FAP action — returns initial view-model on first command after connect.
  - GET /api/v1/_internal/connections — operator endpoint reporting live connection count + per-session metadata. Used by smoke-browser-console.mjs and surfaced as the reviewer's 'real connection count' gate.
  - 5-minute watchdog interval — prunes any session entry older than 1h (failsafe against missed disconnect events).

FAP Guideline reference: §8 (sessionId state block), §11 (refresh and recovery), §19 (Refresh recovery works).

label: AI Insight UI — KPI Broadcast
info:
Scheduled FAP §9 event broadcast of gold-layer Trino KPI aggregates.

Fires every 60s (after a 10s startup delay), fetches a Keycloak token, runs the kpi-summary SQL against gold.net_grid_hourly, builds an EventEnvelope { type:'event', event:'kpi.update', data:{netGrid,pvGeneration,dailyCost,updatedAt,dataAsOf} }, and broadcasts to every connected UIBUILDER client via link-broadcast → dispatcher's link-from-broadcast → merge-session-send (no _socketId = fan-out). Replaces the legacy msg.data.topic = 'kpi.update' emission that previously rode along with on-demand trino.query responses (removed from format-trino-result on 2026-05-05).

Trino / Keycloak failures are swallowed by the catch node; they log a warning and skip the cycle so a single outage does not stop the schedule.

TLS: the http-request nodes use the `aiinsight-tls-noverify` tls-config (defined as the second array element in this file). Trino + Keycloak inside the cluster present self-signed certs from secret-operator, so `verifyservercert` is false. Long-term the cluster CA should be plumbed into a verifying tls-config and we should switch to it.
